_comment: pay_per_container_nm: a ship is paid capacity x leg distance (nm) x this rate when it finishes unloading; tuned so a Scooter 10 earns about $2,000 per minute of sailing. fuel_price: dollars per fuel unit, the same at every port. initial_view_width_deg: how many degrees of longitude the map shows across when it opens, centered on the home port.
